in_marathi.name: Subhakanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Auspicious and Merciful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhakanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subhakanta is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that means 'auspicious and merciful'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'subha' meaning good, prosperous and 'kanta' meaning merciful or kind. The name signifies the presence of prosperity and good fortune in one's life, along with the ability to show compassion and kindness to others.
